Name: Ulster Frame
Information:
**Ulster Frame**

Created from thesite deposits found by Setanta and his macha devas in deep space, the ulster frames were forged for their personal use in the battle against Luminal Minus. Each macha deva has a personal unit bound to them that they can summon and dismiss, but Setanta has occasionally given ulster frames to heroic mortals who he feels might make promising allies one day. The units have fragments of the hide of an ancient exolunar leviathan slain by Setanta built into them. This same sub-planetary-scaled leviathan’s hide was used to reinforce the World Ark, and the remains of the beast are stored within to be used exclusively by Setanta.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The frame unit makes three Spine of Curruid attacks.

actions.name: Spine of Curruid
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target or Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 100/300 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage. After throwing the spine, it vanishes and a new one is produced on the frame unit’s body.

actions.name: Flash Hound
actions.description: The frame unit takes the Dash and Disengage actions, then makes one Spine of Curruid attack with advantage.

actions.name: Cursed Eidomantic Lance (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The frame unit conjures six Spines of Curruid, each of which it launches at a point it can see within 300 feet. The spikes explode into a 20-foot-radius sphere of energy and chaotic thorns, forcing each creature in those areas to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. Each creature that fails takes 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 26 (4d12) lightning damage and is restrained for 1 minute. On a success, they take half as much damage and aren’t restrained. Creatures restrained this way can use an action to attempt a DC 18 Strength check, escaping the thorns on a success. Additionally, creatures restrained this way are cursed until freed, and cannot regain hit points while cursed this way.

bonus_actions.name: Impossibility Reactor (3/Day)
bonus_actions.description: The next attack the frame unit makes is treated as an automatic hit, regardless of their d20 result. If the attack is ranged, its normal and long ranges are doubled.

bonus_actions.name: Sympathetic Gate (1/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The frame unit produces the effects of the sympathetic gateway spell, requiring no spell slot or components.
